name: hip pain overview
title: Hip pain sorted by where the patient points: anterior or groin pain inside the joint (hip osteoarthritis, labral tear), lateral pain (greater trochanteric pain syndrome) and posterior buttock pain (piriformis syndrome), each with its presentation, exam, investigations and treatment in order, plus the socks question that separates lateral hip osteoarthritis from greater trochanteric pain syndrome

nodes.title: 'My hip hurts': ask WHERE
lines: TRUE hip pain (inside the joint) is usually ANTERIOR, in the GROIN
patients often point to the lateral buttock, sometimes to the buttock itself

nodes.title: ANTERIOR / GROIN: usually inside the joint
lines: also: rheumatoid or septic arthritis · osteonecrosis · iliopsoas tendinopathy

nodes.title: LATERAL
lines: hip OA can present here too: ask about SOCKS

nodes.title: Hip osteoarthritis (OA)
lines: primary: idiopathic, elderly · secondary: post-traumatic, younger

nodes.title: Labral tear
lines: all ages · commonly ACTIVE FEMALES

nodes.title: Greater trochanteric pain syndrome (GTPS)
lines: gluteus medius + minimus tendinopathy ± bursitis (iliotibial band friction)

nodes.title: Piriformis syndrome
lines: muscle strain or tendinopathy ± SCIATIC nerve impingement

nodes.title: Groin pain, the 'C' sign
lines: • worse with prolonged activity · night pain
• morning stiffness < 30 min · stiff after long sitting
• crepitus, locking · TROUBLE PUTTING SOCKS ON

nodes.title: Vague groin pain
lines: • CLICKING, catching, snapping
• locking

nodes.title: Pain over the greater trochanter
lines: • CAN'T LIE ON THAT SIDE · worse weight bearing
• ± to the buttock or down the thigh to the knee
• no swelling · SOCKS ON FINE · female > male

nodes.title: Buttock pain
lines: • worse getting out of bed, sitting long, moving the hip
• radicular symptoms down the leg if the nerve is caught
• after buttock trauma, long sitting, anatomic anomalies

nodes.title: INTERNAL ROTATION lost first
lines: • FABER, FADIR, Stinchfield
• antalgic gait · leg length?

nodes.title: POINT TENDERNESS over the trochanter
lines: • highly sensitive · Ober's test +
• single leg stance for 30 s is painful

nodes.title: Tender over piriformis
lines: • Pace, Beatty, FAIR, Freiberg

nodes.title: A CLINICAL diagnosis
lines: • X-ray confirms it, and changes may not match symptoms
• CT or MRI not needed (secondary causes, surgical planning)

nodes.title: MR ARTHROGRAM
lines: • the imaging study of choice
• X-ray only to exclude other causes

nodes.title: A CLINICAL diagnosis
lines: • imaging rarely needed
• ask about a recent increase in activity

nodes.title: Electromyography (EMG)
lines: only if the nerve is involved

nodes.title: 1 · Non-drug
lines: • education, exercise, physio
• weight management, work supports
• tai chi, a cane

nodes.title: 2 · Drugs + injection
lines: • oral anti-inflammatories (NSAIDs), Tylenol, duloxetine
• image-guided injection: steroid, hyaluronic acid or platelet-rich plasma

nodes.title: 3 · Hip replacement
lines: hemi, total or resurfacing

nodes.title: 1 · Physio
lines: stretch the iliotibial band, strengthen the hip abductors · load + weight management

nodes.title: 1 · Physio
lines: stretch piriformis · range of motion · deep massage

panels.title: Lateral pain: GTPS or hip OA?
items: GTPS: pain on activity and lying on it · tender trochanter · single leg stance hurts
hip OA: morning stiffness, groin pain, progressive · socks hard · internal + external rotation painful

panels.title: Tests and the rest
items: FABER = flexion, abduction, external rotation · FADIR or FAIR = flexion, adduction, internal rotation
osteonecrosis: trauma, steroids, alcohol, lupus, sickle cell, radiation
snapping hip: very common · not painful → don't worry about it
